card.name: Spots where the next word starts with bo
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens right before a word that begins with "bo", such as a digit before a number, an opening parenthesis, or "smooth" before "bore". It is a prediction of an upcoming "bo" piece, not a single kind of word.

modes.label: Before bore or bohm
modes.description: A word or piece directly followed by a bo- word piece such as bore or Bohm.
modes.example: 115 mm<< smooth>>bore cannon from the T-6

modes.label: Digits and brackets in drug text
modes.description: A digit or an opening parenthesis in label text, such as a dose number or a drug name in brackets.
modes.example: hepatitis C protease inhibitor<< (>>telaprevir) Avoid ator

modes.label: Joining words in capitals
modes.description: A word like OR in an all-caps warning, or a short piece of a name or acronym.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce a "bo" word piece next, and holds back unrelated non-English characters.
card.plain: It fires on varied small tokens when the model expects the next piece of text to start with "bo".
